reels.title: Fear of an Empty Page in the Book of Life
reels.hook: What if the page of your life is empty?
reels.why: A short and powerful testimony of a woman, spoken through tears, with a clear image of the book of life and empty pages. The point is universal and prompts the viewer to wonder about themselves.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: I am afraid when I come before the Lord that he might open the book of my life and ask me what it is that you did for me

cards.text: What if the page of your life is empty?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of the Ora et Labora podcast
Testimony of a woman at a book promotion
I am afraid when the book of life is opened like that that nothing would be written in my favor
She said it through tears, and the hall applauded her

reels.title: A Basketball Player Is Measured by Statistics, but by What Is a Catholic Measured?
reels.hook: A basketball player is measured by statistics. And a Catholic?
reels.why: A series of familiar comparisons (basketball, football, business report, blood count) builds tension and ends with a provocative question for believers.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Do you have a family, do you have children, how many people have you converted, how many people came to Christ the Lord because of you.

cards.text: A basketball player is measured by statistics. And a Catholic?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Grebenar is engaged in entrepreneurship and business consulting
There are indicators that measure that.
How many people came to Christ the Lord because of you?

reels.hook: 40 days of fasting and a fall from power?

reels.title: Five Converted Souls Are Worth More Than 5 Million Views
reels.hook: Millions of views that are worth nothing
reels.why: The podcast host claims that views are not important, which is unexpected. The contrast of five souls and five million views is easily remembered.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Five converted souls are worth more than 5 million views of something on some podcast or something.

reels.title: Strict Towards Sin, Gentle Towards the Sinner
reels.why: Short and rounded: a clear rule, a vivid image of a cat backed into a corner, and a strong final sentence about the cross.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: One must be very strict with sin, and very gentle and mild towards the sinner.

cards.text: Why condemnation changes no one
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
One must be very strict with sin, and very gentle and mild towards the sinner.
God cast himself away on the cross so that we might be saved.

reels.title: You Do Not Solve a Problem the Way You Created It
reels.hook: The same way of thinking will not solve your problem
reels.why: A business rule applied to marriage and life. Practical advice understood even by a viewer who does not believe.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: So, the way you created a problem in life is not the way you will solve it.

reels.title: They Offer You a Position? First Ask Whether It Is God's Will
reels.hook: They offer you a position? First do this
reels.why: From the Gospel he derives clear and applicable advice. The ending „run away from that, man“ is humorous and strong.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: It is best when someone offers you some place in the hierarchy to say: "Oof, I must first ask the Lord whether it's God's will."

reels.title: Jesus Condemned the Sin, Not the Woman, and the Host Asks for Forgiveness
reels.hook: The podcast host publicly asks for forgiveness
reels.why: The well-known story of the adulteress leads to a personal, vulnerable moment in which the host admits mistakes and publicly apologizes.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Jesus condemned the sin, but not a single person.
